headline: Tropical Depression Neneng Slows East of Taiwan as PAGASA Projects Weakening Into a Low
seoTitle: TD Neneng Slows, Expected to Weaken | FMB News
seoDescription: Tropical Depression Neneng slowed east of Taiwan early August 20 as the approved FMB News brief, citing PAGASA, reported 45 km/h winds and projected weakening into a remnant low.
deck: The cyclone weakened overnight and is expected to lose organization near Taiwan, while residual Habagat showers remain possible over parts of western Luzon.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Tropical Depression Neneng decelerated over the northern Philippine Sea east of Taiwan, with maximum sustained winds of 45 km/h and gusts up to 55 km/h, according to the approved FMB News overnight package citing PAGASA.
The package placed the center about 580 km northeast of Itbayat, Batanes, and said the system was moving slowly northwestward.

sections.heading: Context · What PAGASA expects
paragraphs: Forecasters expect Neneng to weaken into a remnant low as it interacts with Taiwan. The Southwest Monsoon is also expected to ease gradually, although isolated moderate to heavy showers may still affect Zambales, Bataan and Occidental Mindoro.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A weakening cyclone can still affect marine conditions and monsoon rainfall, so residents and seafarers should continue following official weather and local disaster advisories.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch PAGASA for the final cyclone bulletin, updated marine warnings and any remaining heavy-rain advisories as Neneng loses organization.
